flora: Fern frond (detailed pinnatifid structure, leathery texture)
Sori cluster (underside of leaf showing spore-bearing spots)
Rhizome clump (fibrous root base with small emerging stems)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; lush, verdant feel; fronds have rounded, safe edges; focus on the repetitive geometric beauty of the leaves and the fuzzy texture of the fiddleheads.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant composition: Top-Left: a full mature frond; Top-Right: a tightly curled, fuzzy fiddlehead; Bottom-Left: a close-up of spore-bearing sori; Bottom-Right: the thick root base in the silt.
visual_logic.ground: Saturated dark gray mudstone fragments and organic peat.
visual_logic.lighting: Bright, even illumination to distinguish the green plant matter from the dark, damp substrate.
